# Abū Naṣr al-Fārābī

*870 – 950 · Central Asian · [Falsafa](../movements/falsafa.md)*

The "second teacher" after Aristotle: a logician, the thinker of the [virtuous city](../glossary/virtuous-city.md) ruled by the philosopher-prophet, a founding figure of [falsafa](../movements/falsafa.md).
